manualSteps.label: Open process
manualSteps.instruction: Open the isolated workspace. Click Workflows, Workflow files, Open workflow, choose ui-evidence-negative-001.workflow.wflow, then Use saved process.

manualSteps.label: Attach prepared run
manualSteps.instruction: Open the prepared run link; inspect the available document review without approving it.

manualSteps.label: Save UI
manualSteps.instruction: Open its prepared preview. Click Create or choose interface, Save interface, then Open saved interface.

manualSteps.label: Changed or missing evidence
manualSteps.instruction: After the controlled fixture changes or removes the reviewed document, reload each view. Approve must be unavailable and explain which evidence needs refreshing.

manualSteps.label: Changed process
manualSteps.instruction: Open the saved interface link for the changed process revision. Use common working view must remain available; historical evidence must not authorize a new review.
